title: Service only shows only invoices starting with S; Parts only shows only invoices starting with P
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the Sales By Customer report.
2. The date range contains at least one service invoice (number starting with S) and one parts invoice (number starting with P) — seed ZZAUTOTEST data if needed.
steps: 1. Set Product Type to "Service only," expand a customer down to invoice rows, and read the invoice numbers.
2. Set Product Type to "Parts only" and read the invoice numbers again.
expected: 1. Under "Service only," every invoice shown has a number starting with S; parts invoices are gone and all counts/totals reflect only S invoices.
2. Under "Parts only," every invoice shown has a number starting with P; service invoices are gone and all counts/totals reflect only P invoices.
3. The whole invoice is classified by its number prefix — there is no per-line-item split.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: Per-line-item classification is explicitly out of scope (§2) — a mixed invoice classified whole by prefix is expected behavior, not a defect.
